summary: Make operation review brief, clear and editable while preserving evidence, originals and immutable analysis history.
acceptance: Edit operation name/reference on same ID with tenant/role verification, expected fingerprint, bounded before/after audit and no alteration of historical snapshots.
Manage linked documents with explicit removal semantics; originals and previous analyses retained; stale writes fail without losing form drafts.
Results before support panels; semantic red/green/amber with icon/text, faithful counts and no monetary aggregation.
Accessible document/fact/history accordions reduce scrolling while keeping important reference/stale warnings visible.
Group and exactly deduplicate evidence by original document/page/snippet, show concise preview and all unique citations on demand.
Reference preflight displays operation and extracted values; missing reference distinguished from mismatch. Existing rules and uncertainty preserved.
Corrections retain original, reason, author/time and history; changed input warns to reanalyse.
Independent architecture/security/UX/QA/browser evidence, full checks and actual HTTP CI acceptance before verification.
semanticRouting: New operation editing and association concurrency affect contracts, tenant authorization, audit and immutable analysis inputs. Existing deterministic financial rules/parser remain unchanged. Product/domain and UX preimplementation blueprint, architecture preimplementation contract, independent source and browser reviews required.

excludedRoles.reason: No external connector, import transport, queue or adapter change; editing existing operation associations only.
No extraction/parser/model or fact derivation change; existing extracted facts and revisions presented without changing provenance.

limitations: No deployment, claims or accounting approval added.
Local environment has no Docker; actual service acceptance requires CI; browser fixture checks explicitly separate.
independenceRationale: Operation metadata and document association writes affect financial context and tenant data. Independent architecture/security/data review and independent UX/browser/QA are required.
